layers.scope: Breakdown partitions full Markdown BPE tokens by the first byte's line: model_body is published unit explain, summary, extras and uncertainties; signature_location includes shared source-file reference definitions (including ones used by relations); heading_anchor, relations, footer, INDEX and node_text (including labels/whitespace) partition the rest. model_body/source and published_markdown/source use complete frozen files. semantic: all published Markdown (node pages + INDEX, including navigation, signatures and commands); deterministic: catalog.json as serialized, including preserved prose copies and edge references, excluding the graph field; frozen graph is excluded from token ratios (frozen_graph_tokens=0), reported separately as frozen_graph_bytes using UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False and compact separators; complete graph evidence is expanded only with query --edges; source: complete frozen files counted once; context source chunks, host prompts, raw answers and summary.json excluded; layers are storage measures, not disjoint content classes

issues: grp:cJSON.h-platform-and-visibility-macros: says CJSON_PUBLIC expands to plain type, __declspec(dllexport) type, or __declspec(dllimport) type, but the source appends CJSON_STDCALL to each expansion.
grp:cJSON.h-platform-and-visibility-macros: says defining both CJSON_HIDE_SYMBOLS and CJSON_IMPORT_SYMBOLS leaves CJSON_PUBLIC undefined, but the CJSON_HIDE_SYMBOLS branch defines it first.
cJSON.h::module_region::cJSON_SetNumberValue::15296: claims the helper updates valueint per the header, but the header only declares the helper and does not document that side effect.
cJSON_Utils.c::function::decode_pointer_inplace::10413: says an invalid escape leaves the string NUL-terminated at the current decoded position, but the early return skips the final terminator write.

cJSON_Utils.c::function::create_patches::29879: says leftover 'from' elements emit 'remove' with the index as suffix, but the leftover-from loop never increments index, so all such removals use the same index.

cJSON_Utils.c::function::generate_merge_patch::38582 and grp:cJSON_Utils.c-generatemergepatch-entry-points: say NULL when no changes are needed or trees are equal, but equal non-object inputs return a deep duplicate of 'to' instead.

cJSON_Utils.c::function::generate_merge_patch::38582: says objects are walked in key order but does not state that key matching uses strcmp, so case_sensitive=false still treats keys differing only by case as distinct.

cJSON_Utils.c::function::sort_list::13233: says NULL keys sort as 'greater', but compare_strings returns 1 for either NULL and the merge picks the second list on non-negative comparison, so NULL placement is not consistently greater.
cJSON_Utils.c::function::detach_path::11839: says object child detach calls cJSON_DetachItemFromObject but does not note that this ignores case_sensitive, so the flag only affects parent resolution.

grp:cJSON_Utils.c-generatemergepatch-entry-points: says the CaseSensitive variant is case-sensitive, but generate_merge_patch recurses through the case-insensitive public wrapper, so nested common keys are not case-sensitive.

grp:cJSON_Utils.h-cjson-utils-public-header: attributes to the header comment that AddPatchToArray appends an operation/path/value entry, but the comment only calls it a utility for generating patch array entries; append semantics are not stated.

grp:cJSON.c-array-append: says add_item_to_array appends the item and returns true otherwise, but when the array is non-empty and its child->prev tail pointer is NULL the function silently does not attach the item and still returns true, a failure surface the unit omits.
